how_to_use: For task class X use classes.X.first_choice unless it is gated; else the next entry in fallbacks.

method.evidence_rule: An unproven entry (no own jobs) ranks above a proven one only if its priority is more than 0.03 higher and its public_norm is higher.
method.harness_rule: A public metric measured in another agent's harness counts at 0.8x (norm multiplied). The engine's own harness, or a model-only benchmark (no harness or a neutral one), counts in full.

status_meanings.proven: ranked with own jobs from the last 28 days
status_meanings.unproven: public scores only, no own jobs yet
status_meanings.gated: weekly plan usage at or above the gate; skipped
status_meanings.stale: a source behind this row was not refreshed this run
